verdict.rationale: Slate's docs show one TUI that can orchestrate parallel agents. They appear as a grid of inline subagent cards, and double-clicking a card jumps into that agent's full session. You can keep working or spin up more agents while others run in the background. `/sessions` switches between sessions, Ctrl+X N creates a new one, and `/workspace` manages workspace directories. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-session management, and evidence of a single overview of top-level sessions (they are switched between, not shown together) beyond the subagent card grid.
